info.name: Ramein API Automation
info.description:
## Ramein API Automation

This collection contains **103 automated test cases** (TC-API-001 through TC-API-102) covering end-to-end API testing for the **Ramein platform** an event ticketing and management system. All requests are built against the `{{BaseUrl}}` environment variable.

### Modules Covered

| Module | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Health** | API health check endpoint |
| **Authentication** | User registration, login, logout, and token refresh |
| **User** | Retrieve authenticated user profile |
| **Master Data** | Lookup endpoints for categories, cities, and organizers |
| **Events** | Create and explore events; retrieve event details |
| **Transaction** | Create and retrieve ticket purchase transactions |
| **Ticket** | View user tickets and scan QR codes for entry validation |
| **Finance** | View financial summaries for users and admins |
| **Withdraw** | Request and manage creator withdrawal of funds |
| **Feedback** | Submit and retrieve event feedback and creator ratings |
| **Admin** | Admin-level user management and transaction oversight |
| **Event Chat** | Post messages in event chat |
| **Other** | Refresh token, payment notifications, and utility flows |

### Test Structure

Each module is organized into **Positive** and **Negative** sub-folders to validate both expected success scenarios and error/edge-case handling.

### Setup

A **Setup** folder is included to handle prerequisite steps (e.g., authentication token generation) before running the full collection. Use the **BaseUrlRamein** environment to configure the base URL and other required variables such as `token_user`, `token_admin`, `event_id`, and `midtrans_server_key`.
